added.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

An Overview Of This Role

As Director of Engineering, Database Excellence, you will lead the Database Excellence stage and report to the Vice President of Data Engineering. You will set the direction for the databases that support GitLab.com, self-managed GitLab, and GitLab Dedicated. Your organization owns the reliability, capacity, health, and sustainability of GitLab's application datastores, with PostgreSQL as the primary focus alongside Redis, OpenSearch, ClickHouse, and object storage.

You will be accountable for database capacity and availability on GitLab.com. You will guide long-range platform decisions while partnering with Infrastructure, Product, Distribution, Support, Security, and FinOps. The work includes reducing infrastructure costs, improving data growth controls and saturation detection, standardizing database services, rebuilding the self-managed upgrade experience, and contributing to GitLab's company-wide datastore strategy, including Cells partitioning. Learn more in the Database Excellence handbook.

What You’ll Do

Set direction and long-range plans for the database platform in line with company strategy.
Own database capacity and availability outcomes for GitLab.com, and communicate database risk to senior leadership.
Lead and coach three Engineering Managers and develop Staff-plus engineers into leaders.
Drive cross-division technical decisions using data, partnering with Infrastructure, Product, Distribution, Support, Security, and FinOps.
Partner with Product to prioritize database platform investments and make infrastructure tradeoffs in the context of product outcomes.
Own the hiring plan, organization design, retention, and performance management for teams across regions.
Set quarterly objectives and key results and engineering key performance indicators for the stage, and manage the database infrastructure budget with FinOps.
Serve as an escalation point for database incidents, standardize effective processes, and keep the handbook current.

What You’ll Bring

Experience leading managers of managers, including coaching newer managers.
Experience working hands-on with PostgreSQL at scale, including capacity planning, upgrades, replication, performance, and large production clusters.
Experience using data to make strategic technical decisions and connect database platform investments and tradeoffs with product outcomes.
Experience supporting software that customers run themselves, or working through the self-managed upgrade challenge.
Experience leading backend engineering teams that own production infrastructure, applying site reliability engineering practices including service level objectives, on-call operations, incident management, cost management, and automation.
Experience communicating clearly in writing in an asynchronous, handbook-first company.
Experience leading globally distributed remote teams.
Experience with Redis, ClickHouse, OpenSearch, object storage, Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Terraform, Chef, managed database services, FinOps, AI-assisted engineering workflows, or platform and infrastructure organizations is a plus.

About The Team

Database Excellence includes Database Architecture, Database Automation, and Self Managed Database. Three Engineering Managers lead these teams, alongside an Operations Manager. Our teams work across the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and India. Database Architecture provides datastore guidance, data growth controls, and the database review process. Database Automation builds PostgreSQL fleet automation, upgrades, provisioning, health monitoring, and an internal managed PostgreSQL offering. Self Managed Database is rebuilding the upgrade and migration experience for self-managed GitLab. Together, we make database services more reliable, sustainable, and easier to operate across GitLab's deployment models.

added.description:
About the Opportunity

The hiring organization is seeking a strategic and hands-on Director, Infrastructure & IT Operations
to lead the technology capabilities that keep digital products, cloud platforms, and internal teams secure, reliable, and productive.

This role oversees cloud infrastructure, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), production operations, bot mitigation, corporate IT, and helpdesk support, while providing architectural leadership across cloud platforms, networking, identity, observability, and operational tooling. This position spans both internal employee technology and the production infrastructure supporting high-traffic, customer-facing applications.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States.

Key Responsibilities

Lead teams responsible for cloud infrastructure, SRE, production operations, corporate IT, helpdesk, and bot mitigation, establishing ownership, operational standards, service-level objectives (SLOs), escalation procedures, and performance metrics.
Develop managers, technical leads, and IT staff through coaching, career development, and building a culture of accountability, documentation, automation, and continuous improvement.
Build quarterly and annual infrastructure roadmaps aligned with business priorities, growth, security, reliability, and cost, partnering with engineering, product, data, marketing, finance, HR, legal, and executive leadership.
Own the reliability, scalability, security, performance, and cost-effectiveness of cloud infrastructure, primarily within AWS.
Provide architectural leadership across cloud services, applications, APIs, networking, identity, databases, storage, observability, and integrations while establishing architecture standards, reference patterns, governance, and technical review processes.
Partner with engineering to improve deployment safety, performance, and readiness, driving automation, configuration management, and infrastructure as code.
Lead capacity planning for growth and demand spikes, eliminating single points of failure, undocumented systems, manual processes, and single-source dependencies.
Ensure production and nonproduction environments are properly separated, secured, and monitored, reviewing new systems for architectural fit, supportability, security, and total cost of ownership.
Establish and maintain service-level indicators (SLIs), SLOs, availability targets, and error-budget practices for critical systems.
Improve observability through centralized logging, metrics, distributed tracing, application performance monitoring (APM), and actionable alerting.
Lead major incident management, coordination, executive communication, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action tracking to improve mean time to detect, respond, and recover.
Develop and test backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity procedures, and establish sustainable on-call practices.
Own strategy and tooling for bot mitigation, scraping protection, automated abuse prevention, and traffic-quality management using technologies such as Cloudflare, DataDome, web application firewalls (WAFs), rate limiting, CAPTCHA alternatives, and device fingerprinting.
Partner with cross-functional teams to distinguish malicious automation from legitimate customers, search engines, partners, and approved AI crawlers, establishing monitoring and response procedures.
Oversee internal IT services and helpdesk support, establishing service-level expectations for response times, resolution times, user satisfaction, and backlog reduction.
Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, equipment provisioning, access management, asset recovery, and device inventory.
Standardize endpoint configuration, encryption, patching, and endpoint detection across laptops, collaboration platforms, productivity software, and telecom services.
Establish consistent identity and access management practices across corporate and production systems, implementing role-based access, least privilege, multi-factor authentication (MFA), periodic access reviews, and secure administrative account handling.
Support vulnerability remediation, security assessments, audits, vendor reviews, incident readiness, and applicable privacy requirements in partnership with legal and security teams.
Manage infrastructure, security, IT, telecom, monitoring, and support vendors, handling evaluations, contract reviews, renewals, licensing, service level agreements (SLAs), and budget management.
Improve cloud cost visibility through tagging, allocation, forecasting, tool consolidation, and contract optimization.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, SRE, platform engineering, DevOps, IT operations, or related disciplines.
5+ years of experience leading engineering or technology teams, including managing managers or technical leads.
Demonstrated experience operating high-traffic, customer-facing platforms in AWS or a comparable cloud environment.
Strong understanding of cloud architecture, networking, identity, security, observability, databases, APIs, storage, and distributed systems.
Experience managing production availability, incident response, root-cause analysis, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
Experience with infrastructure automation, configuration management, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code.
Experience managing corporate IT, employee support, endpoint management, software licensing, and access provisioning.
Experience establishing operational metrics, SLOs, and support standards.
Demonstrated ability to manage vendors, contracts, departmental budgets, and cloud costs.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks, architecture, and tradeoffs to executive audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Cloudflare, DataDome, or comparable bot-management and web application protection platforms, including leading bot mitigation or traffic-quality programs.
Experience with AWS services, containerized environments, infrastructure as code, centralized logging, and APM tools (such as AppDynamics).
Experience supporting large-scale consumer subscription, public-record, data-as-a-service, advertising, or ecommerce platforms.
Experience modernizing legacy infrastructure, transitioning systems from external vendors, and consolidating cloud accounts or IT services.
Familiarity with privacy requirements and secure handling of sensitive consumer data.
Experience building or maturing SRE, DevOps, or platform engineering functions.

Measures of Success

Improved availability, performance, and stability of customer-facing platforms.
Reduced impact and infrastructure costs associated with bots, scraping, and automated abuse.
Faster incident detection, response, and recovery, alongside a reduction in recurring incidents.
Enhanced observability with reduced alert noise, validated disaster recovery capabilities, and optimized cloud spend.
Consistent helpdesk performance, reliable onboarding and offboarding, and robust endpoint security and asset tracking.
Strong architecture governance, reduced dependency on undocumented systems or vendors, and demonstrated team development.

Retirement benefits with employer match

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Drive the technical foundation and supply integrity of Everpure’s enterprise flash arrays, blades, and server building blocks as Component Engineering Manager. You will lead a high-performing engineering team and serve as the final authority on component qualification, ensuring every storage node, CPU, memory subsystem, and interconnect module meets uncompromising performance and reliability standards. By bridging Hardware Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and global semiconductor vendors, you will directly influence product architecture while safeguarding manufacturing continuity and operational scale.

What You'll Do

Engineering Leadership & Talent Development: Build, direct, and mentor a specialized team of component engineers spanning flash/SSD technologies and server platform hardware, fostering technical growth and setting execution priorities.
End-to-End Component Qualification: Own the complete qualification lifecycle—defining rigorous test plans, analyzing supplier data, and issuing final approval for design-in and mass production across NAND flash, CPUs, DRAM, power systems, and interconnects.
Strategic Flash & SSD Oversight: Drive roadmap alignment and technology node transitions with key storage suppliers, governing media characterization, firmware qualification, and long-term architectural integration.
Supply Resilience & Risk Mitigation: Establish multi-sourcing strategies, lead second-source qualifications, and manage End-of-Life (EOL) and Product Change Notifications (PCN) to eliminate single-point risks and prevent line disruptions.
Root Cause & Quality Accountability: Lead cross-functional Root Cause Corrective Action (RCCA) investigations for complex field and manufacturing failures, utilizing failure analysis frameworks to continuously elevate product quality metrics.
Cross-Functional & Supplier Alignment: Partner with Hardware Engineering during NPI to optimize component selection, and collaborate with Procurement on technical negotiations, vendor scorecards, and cost-reduction initiatives.

What You Bring

Demonstrated expertise in engineering management or technical team leadership within component, hardware, or system engineering organizations.
Deep technical mastery of NAND flash memory, SSD architectures, and comprehensive storage qualification methodologies.
Broad knowledge of server-class hardware subsystems, including CPUs, memory interfaces (DRAM), power delivery, connectors, and PCBA manufacturing requirements.
Proven hands-on capability with risk management frameworks, second-sourcing strategies, EOL/PCN management, and failure analysis methodologies (e.g., 8D, FMEA, RCCA).
Strong collaborative and executive communication skills, with a background presenting technical risk analyses and operational strategy to senior stakeholders and key supplier leadership.

Job Description

Finance Technology is building a dedicated team for the Financial Planning Platform. The Vice President, Fund Finance Technology owns the strategy, roadmap, prioritization, adoption, user experience, and business outcomes for the platform, which helps the organization look forward through forecasting, scenario modeling, strategic planning, performance insights, and decision support. The role works closely with Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Fund Accounting (FA), Finance leadership, investment teams and other relevant front-office stakeholders, the Corporate Strategy Group (CSG), Enterprise Technology, Enterprise Data Engineering, Reporting & BI, application teams, and delivery partners. CSG leads the broader program and project execution, while this role provides direction, platform ownership, user experience leadership, and long-term roadmap accountability. This is a hands-on role requiring direct engagement with users, planning data, models, formulas, calculations, assumptions, drivers, workflows, integrations, reporting, and platform configuration. The role requires frequent engagement with senior finance and business leaders and is expected to become a trusted partner in shaping how finance users plan, forecast, evaluate scenarios, and make strategic decisions. Success requires strong judgment, curiosity, credibility, and the ability to build trust with users and senior leadership.

REPORTING RELATIONSHIPS

Reports to: Finance Technology leadership; aligned to the Financial Planning Platform capability

Supervises: None initially; provides leadership across internal teams and delivery partners

Primary Functions & Responsibilities

Forward-looking planning, scenarios, and decision support

Own the platform roadmap supporting forecasting, budgeting, scenario modeling, strategic planning, workforce planning, performance management, and management decision support.
Partner with FP&A, Fund Accounting, Finance leadership, and investment teams and other relevant front-office stakeholders to understand business drivers, assumptions, investment activity, fund performance, capital deployment, growth opportunities, risks, and potential outcomes.
Improve the speed, quality, and transparency of forward-looking analysis and help users compare scenarios and understand the impact of changing assumptions.
Translate complex financial and operational questions into intuitive platform solutions, analytics, workflows, and decision-support experiences.

Strategy, roadmap, and outcomes

Own the platform vision, strategy, roadmap, investment priorities, and backlog.
Lead discovery and translate user and business needs into clear problems, intended outcomes, requirements, acceptance criteria, and prioritized work.
Make practical trade-offs across value, user impact, complexity, risk, dependencies, timing, and delivery capacity.
Operate effectively in ambiguous environments by defining problems, establishing priorities, and creating structure where formal processes may not yet exist.
Define success measures and use adoption, user feedback, business value, platform health, and delivery outcomes to guide decisions.
Create and present clear presentation materials covering product strategy, roadmaps, investment priorities, business cases, delivery progress, adoption, and outcomes.
Influence strategic priorities and investment decisions through data-driven recommendations, business cases, roadmap proposals, and executive communication.

Hands-on platform and data leadership

Develop working knowledge of platform data, models, formulas, calculations, assumptions, dimensions, hierarchies, workflows, integrations, reporting structures, and dependencies.
Work directly with users, data, models, configuration, calculations, and reporting outputs to understand issues and identify improvements.
Investigate platform, data, workflow, and reporting issues directly rather than relying exclusively on support teams or partners.
Participate actively in solution design, model reviews, testing, release validation, and platform evaluations.
Work closely with planning modelers and engineers to translate product priorities and user needs into scalable model designs, formulas, workflows, integrations, and user experiences.

AI-enabled workflows and user experience

Identify opportunities to improve projections, scenario analysis, planning workflows, user experience, productivity, insights, and decision-making through AI-enabled capabilities.
Partner with Enterprise Technology, enterprise AI teams, and relevant data teams to evaluate, prioritize, and deliver practical AI-driven solutions.
Help move successful prototypes into governed, reusable, secure, and supportable platform solutions.
Apply user research, journey and workflow analysis, prototyping, feedback, and adoption practices to create simpler, more intuitive experiences.
Drive adoption by helping users embrace new processes, technologies, workflows, and AI-enabled ways of working.

Relationships, trust, and senior leadership engagement

Serve as the primary product partner within Finance Technology for FP&A, Fund Accounting, Finance leadership, investment teams and other relevant front-office stakeholders.
Build trusted, durable relationships by listening closely, understanding user challenges, communicating transparently, and delivering reliably.
Act as a credible thought partner rather than a requirements collector, helping stakeholders frame problems, evaluate options, and make decisions.
Influence cross-functional teams without direct authority and align stakeholders with competing priorities.
Communicate direction, priorities, progress, risks, dependencies, and decisions clearly to users and senior leadership.

Data, reporting, and delivery partnership

Work hand in hand with the Corporate Strategy Group (CSG), which leads the broader program and project execution, to align scope, priorities, governance, milestones, risks, communications, adoption, and benefits realization.
Provide product direction, platform expertise, user experience leadership, and long-term roadmap ownership within CSG-led transformation initiatives.
Partner with Enterprise Technology, Enterprise Data Engineering, Data Governance, Reporting & BI, application, AI, and delivery teams to define needs and scalable solutions while maintaining Finance Technology ownership of platform outcomes and user experience.
Help establish clear ways of working with planning modelers and engineers, including defined handoffs across product direction, model design, engineering, testing, release readiness, support, and continuous improvement.
Promote governed data sources, consistent definitions, appropriate controls, lineage, and clear ownership.
Ensure releases meet business requirements, acceptance criteria, control expectations, and operational readiness standards.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline. Equivalent relevant experience will be considered.

Experience Required

8+ years in product or technology leadership, product management, Finance Technology, enterprise applications, financial systems, data products, or a related role in a controlled enterprise environment.

Must-have capabilities

Exceptional product leadership across discovery, user experience, roadmap development, prioritization, backlog management, adoption, and outcome measurement.
Experience owning an enterprise product or platform from strategy through delivery, adoption, support, and continuous improvement.
Ability to work with forecasting, budgeting, scenario, and driver-based planning models, including assumptions, calculations, and business drivers.
Exceptional relationship-building skills and the ability to establish trust with users, Finance leaders, technology teams, front-office stakeholders, and senior executives.
Strong executive communication, storytelling, and presentation skills.
Ability and willingness to work hands-on with data, formulas, calculations, assumptions, models, workflows, reporting, integrations, and platform configuration concepts.
Strong analytical problem-solving, user experience, process design, and change adoption skills.

Strongly preferred

Working knowledge of SQL for analysis, validation, troubleshooting, and root-cause investigation.
Python or similar scripting and automation experience.

Asurion — the world’s leading connected device protection company, serving 300M+ customers — is looking for a hands-on Director of PM to own the strategy and roadmap for our Data Platform. Partner with engineering on architecture decisions: when to use streaming vs. batch, how to structure the lakehouse, what belongs in the warehouse vs. the lake.
Align data engineering, analytics, data science, security, and business stakeholders around a shared platform vision.
Hire, develop, and lead a high-performing team of data-fluent PMs.

10+ years in product management, with a significant focus on data platform, infrastructure, or analytics products.
Fluency with the modern data stack: Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, MLflow), Snowflake, Amazon EMR/Spark, and cloud-native data services on AWS or GCP.
Experience building or evolving core platform capabilities: data catalog, metadata management, column-level lineage, pipeline orchestration (Airflow, dbt, or similar), RBAC, and data quality frameworks.
Understands the producer/consumer dynamic — knows that a great platform is as much about how data gets in as how it gets used.
Proven cross-functional leadership; strong communicator from the board room to the engineering standup.
Customer-obsessed with a strong bias for outcomes over output.

Experience standing up a data mesh or domain-oriented data ownership model.
Familiarity with ML/AI workflows and feature stores that consume platform data.
Background partnering with security and privacy teams on governance at scale.

Build at scale — petabytes of data, real-time decisions, 300M+ customers.
Greenfield platform scope inside a well-resourced, high-growth organization.
Direct influence on how every team across the company discovers and uses data.
Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a flexible hybrid work model.

The Basics:

Our Product Management team is actively seeking a new Director of Product Management focused on Data Platform, Cloud, and SaaS Architecture
to join our passionate, driven, and fast-paced team. In this role, you will own and shape Tanium’s end-to-end data strategy across cloud and SaaS environments, partnering closely with engineering, product, design, and cross-functional leadership to define how Tanium stores, accesses, queries, moves, and visualizes data across the platform.

You will bring deep experience in cloud and SaaS architectures, data platforms, and enterprise-scale systems, with the ability to translate complex customer, product, and technical requirements into actionable strategy and execution. You will need to be successful influencing cross-functionally across all levels of the organization, operating horizontally across multiple teams and pods, and drive clarity in ambiguous, complex technical domains. You must also be comfortable setting strategic direction while staying close enough to the work to make high-quality product and architecture decisions.

This is an individual contributor role.

Responsibilities

Own the product strategy and roadmap for Tanium’s cloud/SaaS data platform, from ideation through launch, in close partnership with engineering teams.
Define and drive the short- and long-term roadmap for Tanium’s end-to-end data architecture, including storage, access, query, visualization, and data movement capabilities.
Partner with Product Managers, Engineering, Design, and leadership across the organization to align priorities across multiple pods and ensure teams are building toward a cohesive data strategy.
Lead product direction for how data is surfaced and experienced in Atlas and the UI, with a focus on improving trust, usability, reliability, and customer value.
Drive the strategy for data movement and integration capabilities, including export, import, and scalable data exchange patterns across products and use cases.
Establish clear product requirements, technical specifications, use cases, business logic, and success metrics for data platform capabilities.
Partner with engineering leadership to make durable architectural decisions across complex, distributed cloud and SaaS systems.
Champion data quality as a core product priority, setting expectations and mechanisms to improve consistency, reliability, and trust throughout the data lifecycle.
Collaborate with internal teams on enablement, training, and launch materials to ensure successful adoption of new data capabilities and platform improvements.
Work closely with business, technical, customer-facing, and go-to-market teams to understand customer needs, solve daily challenges, and identify opportunities for product differentiation.
Leverage innovation and trends in cloud, SaaS, data architecture, analytics, and enterprise platform technologies to develop strategic solutions.

Requirements

Education

BA/BS required
MA/MS or equivalent advanced technical/business degree preferred

Experience

8+ years of total professional experience in enterprise B2B software, with at least 5 years in product management supporting a SaaS, cloud platform, data platform, infrastructure, or security technology product.
Proven experience leading product strategy for complex technical platforms, including the ability to define opportunities, translate customer needs into requirements, and deliver products at enterprise scale.
Deep experience with cloud and SaaS architectures, with strong working knowledge of hyperscaler environments such as Azure and/or AWS.
Strong data platform experience, including one or more of the following:
Data storage and data access architectures
Query layers and large-scale database systems
Data visualization and analytics experiences
Data movement, export/import, integration, or interoperability capabilities
Data quality, reliability, governance, and lifecycle considerations

Experience working across distributed systems and multiple product surfaces, rather than a single narrowly defined application or monolith.
Experience with large-scale enterprise data systems; experience with graph databases is a plus.
Strong track record of working with engineering and business stakeholders to drive product definition, strategic alignment, prioritization, and execution.
Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, quickly ramp into new technical domains, and bring structure to broad, evolving problem spaces.
Proven ability to influence horizontally across cross-functional teams, product pods, and senior stakeholders.
Technology background preferred, ideally with experience in security, systems management, IT operations, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, or enterprise platform products.

Experience with graph databases or graph-based data models.
Experience with large-scale database systems, analytics platforms, or enterprise data visualization products.
Broader hyperscaler depth across Azure, AWS, and/or other cloud providers.
Experience building durable export/import patterns and integrations across complex enterprise products.
Experience leading product teams through organizational growth, hiring, or team structure evolution.
